headline: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
context: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.
